This update brings new ways to organize your medications and health routines:

- Easier daily tracking: Confirm doses with a tap, reschedule tasks, and choose from more snooze options for reminders.
- A clearer calendar: Look back at past entries and check upcoming days.
- Low stock notifications: Get a reminder when your medication supply is running low.

Thank you for choosing MyTherapy as your daily health companion.
results.description:
Stay consistent with your medications and build healthy routines—one day at a time. MyTherapy helps you remember doses, understand your progress, and care for yourself or a loved one, with everyday health routines in one place.

As your medication reminder, MyTherapy fits around your day with flexible alerts and a personalized medication plan. Check what you’ve taken with the pill tracker, follow your measurements in clear charts, and use family profiles to help organize a loved one’s care.

Key features at a glance:

● Pill Reminder & Medication Alarm: Set flexible, personalized reminders for pills, medications, and treatments—reliable and easy to adjust to your routine. Confirm doses with a tap and choose from several snooze options when you want a reminder again later.

● Personal Medication Plan: Keep a clear overview of your medications, including a daily log to track what you’ve taken. Use the calendar view to look back at past entries, see upcoming tasks, and reschedule items when plans change.

● Refill & Prescription Reminders: Stay prepared—get notified before your medication runs out or when it’s time for your next prescription.

● Injection Site Tracking: Easily document and rotate injection sites to support safe and effective treatment.

● Blood Pressure & Weight Tracking: Get reminders for more than 20 health measurements and record them directly in MyTherapy. Track your weight over time with built‑in weight loss support to help you reach and maintain your health goals.

● Progress Charts & Custom Tracking: Follow your measurements and activities over time with clear charts. Add your own measurements and activities to track what matters to you.

● Apple Health Integration: Automatically sync your weight, steps, water intake, and more—so all your health data stays connected.

● Symptom & Pain Diary: Log symptoms such as fatigue, pain, or skin changes to better understand your condition and treatment progress.

● Streaks: Stay consistent—build strong routines by tracking your daily progress and maintaining your streaks.

● Health Reports & Overview: Turn your data into clear reports to support better conversations with your doctor.

● Family Profiles: Manage multiple profiles in one account to help children, parents, or other loved ones keep track of their medication and health routines.

● Personal Settings: Choose shapes and colors for your medications and customize reminder sounds. Dark mode follows your device settings.

Helpful for people managing conditions such as:
- ADHD (attention deficit/hyperactivity disorder)
- Asthma
- Diabetes (type 1 and type 2)
- Heart disease (e.g. high blood pressure, CHD, atrial fibrillation)
- Obesity
and for anyone managing multiple medications, building healthier routines, or supporting a loved one with their treatment.

Your health data belongs to you. We follow strict security practices and are independently certified to international standards, including ISO 13485 and ISO 27001.

For more information and helpful insights, visit http://www.mytherapyapp.com
